entries.text: I didn't do anything. I took care of him. I-I sang to him... You know, so he wouldn't be afraid.
entries.speaker: Ronnie Purnell

entries.text: Afraid of who? Who was he afraid of, ronnie? Somebody else involved? Somebody else make you do it? He take that other kid, too? Billy's brother? He take him? You're afraid of him, too, aren't you? You're a victim, just like those other kids. Is that right? You... Me, Billy. This is our chance, man. What's his name?
entries.speaker: John Doggett

entries.text: FBI! Cal jeppy! Come out! All right. It's okay, josh. You're okay. We're not going to hurt you.

entries.text: Agent Doggett... He's on the run.

entries.text: I don't believe it.

entries.text: Okay, the clothes, the age and condition of the bones the location of the grave. There is no doubt that that is Billy underwood's skeleton that is in that grave.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: We spent time with this boy. Doctors took Billy's blood. You examined him yourself. Now, I can't accept it. I can't believe we're asking them to.
entries.speaker: John Doggett

entries.text: I know but the forensic evidence is going to come out, and what then? What if I'm right?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Well, what then, agent Scully? What do we do? We move on, let it go, case closed?
entries.speaker: John Doggett

entries.text: Look, I know where you are with this. I have been there. I know what you're feeling-- that you've failed and that you have to explain this somehow. And maybe you can.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Not if that's Billy's body, I can't.
entries.speaker: John Doggett

entries.text: But maybe that's explanation enough. That that's not Billy's brother lying in that grave, too. That that man who did this is never going to be able to do it again. Isn't that what you wanted, agent Doggett?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Agent Scully, don't ask me to believe that this is some kind of justice from beyond the grave.
entries.speaker: John Doggett

entries.text: All I'm saying is that maybe you succeeded... Whether you're willing to see that or not.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
